What We Fix On-Site

Mobile Car Repair Services Available Across Dubai

Targeted mechanical and electrical services performed safely at your parking location, with clear estimates provided before work begins.

Car Battery Testing & Replacement

AED 180–680 [CONFIRM: mobile battery replacement package pricing range]✓ Fully Mobile

On-site digital conductance and load testing to confirm battery health, reserve capacity, and starting draw. When replacement is necessary, we supply and fit OEM-specification AGM, EFB, or flooded batteries matched to your vehicle's DIN dimensions and cold cranking amps (CCA). Includes alternator charging circuit test and terminal anti-corrosion treatment.

OBD-II Multi-System Diagnostics

AED 80–130 [CONFIRM: mobile diagnostic scan pricing]✓ Fully Mobile

On-site electronic interrogation across powertrain (PCM), transmission (TCM), ABS/stability, and body control modules (BCM). We scan active and pending diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs), evaluate live sensor parameters, and determine whether the issue is a failed sensor or a mechanical fault requiring workshop intervention.

Regulated Jump Start & Alternator Check

AED 60–100 [CONFIRM: jump start service fee]✓ Fully Mobile

Safe jump-start assistance using commercial voltage-regulated booster packs, protecting sensitive ECU circuits against load-dump voltage spikes. We immediately verify alternator output voltage (13.8V–14.4V under load) and diode ripple before leaving to ensure your vehicle does not stall in traffic.

Mobile Engine Oil & Filter Change

AED 119–410 [CONFIRM: mobile oil change pricing range]✓ Fully Mobile

Routine lube servicing performed cleanly at your residential or commercial parking bay using sealed spill-containment equipment. We drain degraded oil, install an OEM-grade filter with a fresh sump crush washer, and refill with manufacturer-approved synthetic oil matching required viscosity and API/ACEA specifications. Waste oil is collected for certified recycling.

AC Pressure Diagnostic & Refrigerant Top-Up

AED 130–380 [CONFIRM: mobile AC top-up pricing range]✓ Fully Mobile

On-site manifold gauge pressure diagnostics across high and low service ports for systems blowing warm. If the compressor clutch engages and the sealed refrigerant circuit holds pressure, we top up R134a or R1234yf refrigerant to factory weight. Systems with severe pressure leaks or compressor failure are referred to our workshop.

On-Site Tyre Puncture Plug-Patch Repair

AED 55–80 [CONFIRM: tyre puncture repair price]✓ Fully Mobile

Tread-centre puncture inspection and permanent vulcanising plug-patch repair where tyre structure and puncture angle permit. Includes pneumatic pressure equalization and TPMS sensor verification. Sidewall cuts, shoulder punctures, or severely aged rubber requiring mounting machinery are referred to our workshop tyre bay.

Brake System Inspection & Fluid Top-Up

From AED 80 [CONFIRM: mobile brake inspection fee]Partial On-Site

Wheel-off visual inspection of brake pad friction material thickness, rotor disc scoring, and hydraulic caliper slider condition. We test brake fluid boiling point and top up reservoirs on-site. Complete disc rotor skimming or pad replacements require our Al Satwa workshop hydraulic ramps for safety and calibrated torque compliance.

Engine Air & Cabin Microfilter Replacement

AED 50–150 [CONFIRM: filter replacement pricing range]✓ Fully Mobile

Rapid on-site replacement of dust-saturated engine intake air filters and activated carbon cabin filters. In Dubai's arid climate, airborne particulate accumulation chokes engine induction and creates musty air conditioning odour; regular replacement restores airflow and HVAC efficiency.

Cooling System Inspection & Fluid Top-Up

AED 70–160 [CONFIRM: coolant inspection and top-up price]✓ Fully Mobile

Thermal inspection of radiator hoses, expansion tank pressure cap, and visible engine hose couplings for heat degradation or crusting. We top up cooling circuits with premixed manufacturer-grade OAT or HOAT coolant. Active radiator leaks, failed water pumps, or thermostat housing cracks require workshop towing to prevent severe engine overheating.

Repairs Requiring Our Al Satwa Workshop -Honest Advice First

Certain automotive repairs cannot be carried out safely or reliably in a parking bay without heavy hydraulic lifts, precision torque rigs, or controlled cleanroom environments. Attempting complex structural or internal repairs roadside compromises safety. If your vehicle requires workshop intervention, we explain the reasons clearly and coordinate the transition.

AC compressor replacement, evaporator core teardown, and nitrogen decay leak testing
Brake pad and disc rotor replacement (requires hydraulic lift and precision caliper torquing)
Timing belt, timing chain, and water pump mechanical replacements
Cylinder head gasket replacement and internal engine rebuilding or overhauling
Four-wheel laser alignment and dynamic high-speed wheel balancing
Tyre demounting, bead seating, and new tyre machine fitting
Automatic and manual transmission servicing, torque converter, and gearbox repairs
Suspension control arm, hydraulic bushing press-fit, and shock absorber replacement
How It Works

How Our Mobile Mechanic Service Works -4 Simple Steps

STEP 1

Call or Share Location via WhatsApp

Contact us via phone at +971 56 612 1423 or WhatsApp. Provide your vehicle make, model, year, parking location, and a description of the symptoms, no-start condition, or dashboard warnings.

STEP 2

Triage & Technician Dispatch

Our Al Satwa team evaluates the fault to verify on-site feasibility. A technician is dispatched with multi-system scanners, electrical testing meters, and vehicle-matched consumables.

STEP 3

On-Site Mechanical Diagnostics

Upon arrival, the mechanic performs hands-on testing—whether OBD-II scan, battery conductance test, or fluid pressure check. You receive a clear explanation and an itemised quotation before work begins.

STEP 4

On-Site Repair or Workshop Coordination

Approved mobile services are executed cleanly on the spot. If the fault requires workshop lifting equipment or extensive mechanical dismantling, we coordinate safe transfer to our 222 Al Satwa Road facility.
